advisories.impact: The advisory affects only unstable React Server Components APIs; this client-rendered SPA does not import or enable those APIs.
advisories.rationale: The official advisory rates the issue moderate and no patched React Router 7.x package is published. Compatible transitive findings were upgraded; a forced downgrade or unreviewed major migration would add unrelated risk.
advisories.follow_up: Recheck for a patched 7.x release or complete a tested React Router 8 migration before DEV-024 release verification.
